Tracks file changes with git-like versioning for any project

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of skylv-file-versioning—standalone, git-style version control for any file.
- Track file changes: snapshots, diff, full history, tags, and restore, with no git required.
- Supports text and binary files; SHA-256 content hashing and line-by-line diffs.
- Tag and restore milestones, auto-snapshot in watch mode, and direct file-to-file comparison.
- Pure Node.js; stores all version data locally in a hidden project folder.
